爱莎贝儿-151CM-L 粉肤 RAD055 和泉理夏Izumi Rika-圣物
被选中的是一根巨大圣物，在昏暗烛光中被赋予神圣使命。
古老仪式悄然展开，四周竖立着无数同样雄伟的圣物。
她睁大眼睛，惊讶又羞涩地望着这片奇异景象，呼吸渐渐急促，湿意渐袭，身体轻轻发颤。
胸型：151CM-L 粉肤

Elsa Babe-151CM-L Pink RAD055, Izumi Rika-Sacred Relic
The chosen object was a colossal sacred relic, imbued with a divine mission in the dim candlelight.
An ancient ritual quietly unfolded, surrounded by countless equally magnificent sacred objects.
She stared wide-eyed at this strange spectacle, astonished and shy, her breathing quickening, a dampness settling in, and her body trembling slightly.
Body type: 151CM-L with Pink skin tone.
